candidate.definition_en: To commit oneself to and begin a task; to take on a responsibility.
candidate.explanation_ar: تتولى مسؤولية مهمة أو تبدأ في تنفيذ مشروع.

senses.definition_en: To commit oneself to and begin a task, project, or responsibility.
senses.explanation_ar: يتولى مهمة أو يبدأ في تنفيذ مشروع أو يتحمل مسؤولية.
examples: Students undertake simple experiments in the science laboratory.
Only qualified engineers should undertake such complex construction projects.

senses.definition_en: To formally agree or promise to do something.
senses.explanation_ar: يتعهد أو يلتزم رسمياً بفعل شيء ما.
examples: The university agreed to undertake a comprehensive review of its curriculum.
Students undertake simple experiments in the science laboratory.
